task:
UI redesign phase 6a — home polish (plan: `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-02-v3-ui-redesign-plan.md`, on main, §4 row P6a and "Phase 6 — home polish and final visual sweep"; P6b, the final journey-wide sweep, is a SEPARATE later PR — do not do it here). START from current `main` (design kit #998, P2a #1005, P5b #1004 merged; P3 #1006 is an open PR touching Explore — do not touch Explore/Finder files so it merges cleanly). apps/web only; no backend, route or data change; no new route, no fourth tool.

WHAT TO BUILD in `apps/web/src/routes/+page.svelte` (its `<style>`), `app.css` only for shared home/shell tokens it truly needs, and `WorkspaceHeader`/shell styles only where the home page exposes an inconsistency:
1. Hero: keep the existing primary **Explore the galaxy** and secondary **Inspect a system** actions and the sign-in note; adopt the kit (Saira HUD heading, orange primary pill, neon-blue secondary outline pill as elsewhere, kit spacing scale and type ramp, panel gloss where the kit uses it). The decorative compass/orbit art stays decorative: give it `aria-hidden`/empty alt semantics and copy that never suggests it is map or catalogue data (the plan's truth rule: decorative home art must not masquerade as factual map content).
2. Tool cards (Explore / Inspect / Plan): same three cards, same hrefs and actions; consistent kit card skin (panel, border, hover/focus-visible ring with the kit focus token, icon tile, title, one-line description, the arrow affordance), equal heights in a row at desktop, stacked at phone width, and the P5b note "Review & export — Available in Plan" kept truthful (it must link or clearly point to Plan; no new tool card).
3. Typography/spacing: align heading sizes, eyebrow labels ("Your next destination starts here", "Choose your next step"), paragraph measure and section gaps with the kit's scale used on Explore/Inspect/Plan; fix any mismatch you find between home and the shared `WorkspaceHeader` (nav underline, sign-in pill) — shared changes must keep every other page's existing tests green.
4. Responsive: verify 1280×800, 1024×768, 768×1024 and 390×844 (these are the viewports `foundation.cy.ts` already uses) — no horizontal overflow, cards never overlap, hero actions wrap cleanly; reduced motion disables any hover/transition animation you add; focus order is hero primary → secondary → tool cards in DOM order.
5. Tokens only (`design-kit.test.ts` must pass; no literal colours or `var(--x, literal)` fallbacks).

TESTS: extend `routes/page.test.ts` (home links/hrefs unchanged, three cards, decorative art hidden from AT, "Available in Plan" text, no fourth tool) and the design-kit/shared skin tests for anything shared you touched; keep `foundation.cy.ts` green and extend it only if a new layout fact (e.g. card bounds at phone width) is worth pinning, with axe. Update plan doc §4 row P6a to "implemented in this PR" and add a dated CHANGES.md entry (`## 2026-11-03 — UI redesign P6a: home polish`, newest first; the log uses dated headings, not an Unreleased section).

RULES: pnpm 11.25.0, `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`, then `pnpm check`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm format:check`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm build` must all pass before you push (run `pnpm format` if needed); run the Python contract tests you touched (`tests/test_v3_product_journey_contract.py` pins `foundation.cy.ts`). Do not touch `frontend/`, backend, sql/, workflows, deploy/ or scripts/. No new dependencies, no new images/fonts (the kit's self-hosted Saira is already there). In the PR body list the shared files you touched and why.
